//| echo: false
creation = d3.min(
  table_commit.map(d => new Date(d.Date))
)

last_modification = d3.max(
  table_commit.map(d => new Date(d.Date))
)

creation_string = creation.toLocaleString("fr", {
  "day": "numeric",
  "month": "long",
  "year": "numeric"
})

last_modification_string = last_modification.toLocaleString("fr", {
  "day": "numeric",
  "month": "long",
  "year": "numeric"
})

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false

// Historique du fichier sous forme d'arbre git (style: styles/styles.css, `.fh-*`).
// L'historique d'un fichier est linéaire (`git log --follow`) : une seule ligne,
// du commit le plus récent (en haut) à la création du fichier (en bas).
git_history_graph = {
  const lang = document.documentElement.lang === "en" ? "en" : "fr"
  const labels = {
    fr: {latest: "dernière version", created: "création", plain: "commit", pr: "commit issu d'une pull request", by: "par"},
    en: {latest: "latest", created: "created", plain: "commit", pr: "commit from a pull request", by: "by"}
  }[lang]

  const commits = (table_commit || []).map(d => {
    // "(#667)" en fin de message: numéro de la pull request, affiché sous forme de pastille
    const pr = d.Description.match(/\s*\(#(\d+)\)\s*$/)
    return {
      sha: d.SHA,
      author: d.Author,
      // "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" -> ISO 8601, que tous les navigateurs savent lire
      date: new Date(d.Date.replace(" ", "T")),
      message: pr ? d.Description.slice(0, pr.index) : d.Description,
      pr: pr ? pr[1] : null
    }
  })

  if (commits.length === 0) return html`<em>-</em>`

  const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang, {day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric"})
  const fmtFull = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(lang, {dateStyle: "full", timeStyle: "short"})

  // une ligne par commit, avec un séparateur à chaque changement d'année
  const rows = []
  commits.forEach((c, i) => {
    const year = c.date.getFullYear()
    if (i === 0 || year !== commits[i - 1].date.getFullYear()) {
      rows.push(html`<li class="fh-row fh-year ${i === 0 ? "fh-top" : ""}">${year}</li>`)
    }
    const isFirst = i === 0
    const isLast = i === commits.length - 1
    const head = isFirst ? html`<span class="fh-pill fh-pill-head">${labels.latest}</span>` : ""
    const root = isLast ? html`<span class="fh-pill fh-pill-root">${labels.created}</span>` : ""
    const pr = c.pr ? html`<a class="fh-pill fh-pill-pr" href="${github_repo}/pull/${c.pr}">#${c.pr}</a>` : ""
    const title = html`<div class="fh-title">${head}${root}<a class="fh-sha" href="${github_repo}/commit/${c.sha}">${c.sha}</a><span class="fh-msg">${c.message}</span>${pr}</div>`
    const meta = html`<div class="fh-meta" title="${fmtFull.format(c.date)}">${fmt.format(c.date)} · ${labels.by} ${c.author}</div>`
    rows.push(html`<li class="fh-row fh-commit ${c.pr ? "fh-pr" : ""} ${isFirst ? "fh-first" : ""} ${isLast ? "fh-last fh-root" : ""}"><span class="fh-dot"></span>${title}${meta}</li>`)
  })

  // Les gabarits html tiennent sur une seule ligne: en sortie Typst, ce code n'est pas
  // interprété par Quarto et pandoc le lit comme du markdown; une balise `<div` en début
  // de ligne y ouvrirait une vraie div.
  const legend = html`<div class="fh-legend"><span><span class="fh-dot"></span>${labels.plain}</span><span class="fh-pr"><span class="fh-dot"></span>${labels.pr}</span></div>`
  return html`<div class="fh"><div class="fh-scroll"><ol class="fh-list">${rows}</ol></div>${legend}</div>`
}
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function replacePullRequestPattern(inputString, githubRepo) {
    // Use a regular expression to match the pattern #digit
    var pattern = /#(\d+)/g;

    // Replace the pattern with ${github_repo}/pull/#digit
    var replacedString = inputString.replace(pattern, '[#$1](' + githubRepo + '/pull/$1)');

    return replacedString;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
table_commit = {

// Get the HTML table by its class name
var table = document.querySelector('.commit-table');

// Check if the table exists
if (table) {
    // Initialize an array to store the table data
    var dataArray = [];

    // Extract headers from the first row
    var headers = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < table.rows[0].cells.length; i++) {
        headers.push(table.rows[0].cells[i].textContent.trim());
    }

    // Iterate through the rows, starting from the second row
    for (var i = 1; i < table.rows.length; i++) {
        var row = table.rows[i];
        var rowData = {};

        // Iterate through the cells in the row
        for (var j = 0; j < row.cells.length; j++) {
            // Use headers as keys and cell content as values
            rowData[headers[j]] = row.cells[j].textContent.trim();
        }

        // Push the rowData object to the dataArray
        dataArray.push(rowData);
    }
  }

  return dataArray

}
```
